notes_for_editor: Thin record. The Forest Lookouts Hooks page gives only a name, county and agency. The Forest Fire Lookout Association index gives coordinates and status Gone. The Texas Escapes page covers the town, not the tower. No build date, staffing, fire history, removal date or site description was found. The 2.3 km southwest figure in the story is computed from the two coordinate pairs (tower from the index, town point from Texas Escapes); no source states it. The brief gave access as unknown and no source supports an access level, so no access key is recorded. Search results include a KLLI-FM (Hooks) broadcast tower on anyplaceamerica.com; it is not the lookout and must not be taken as its site. The 2011 tnlandforms Texas tower list has no Hooks entry. Not read: the TSHA Handbook entry for Hooks, which may cover the town only. The story is about 130 words because the sources say no more; it was not padded.
